decisions.statement: The seat call is asked with one JSON payload on its input stream.
A value written into a payload is escaped before the payload is composed.
An attribute nobody stated is left out of the payload rather than sent empty.
The words a caller typed are sorted into slots by the seat call rather than here.
A sort that will not answer stops the launch rather than guessing the slots.
A seat's name is spelled by the seat call rather than by the shell.
A name the seat call would not spell seats the persona under its own name.
A seat is given a default and a mode in a call apart from its attributes.
A seat with no mode returns decisions that seat would otherwise put to its principal.
A seat a person handles states no principal.
Either call failing is said on the error stream and the launch carries on.
Where the seat call sits is asked of the index rather than spelled.
That path is answered once as this module loads.

definition: the shell a launcher reads and writes a seat's attributes through
